set: operator-box intake acceptance — 16 failure classes (unit ACC-001, v25.2.23)
note: One message per failure class, 16 exactly. DATA ONLY: nothing here executes. Running this set makes LIVE paid model calls on the OPERATOR BOX — only with Trevor's explicit go, and the cost figure must be stated FIRST (see README.md, 'The 16-message operator-box set'). run_intake_acceptance.py does NOT read this file (its SPLITS dict lists only corpus_train.json / corpus_frozen.json, lines 46-47), so adding it changes nothing about that harness. Every 'rule' below is a verbatim quote from this repo at branch v25.2.23-cc-pin-and-intake-tests; file:line per quote.
decision_vocabulary: answer_no_card — the CEO answers directly; no call, no card
one_card — exactly one mc-route.sh task call; exactly one card
two_cards — two task calls, one per job; two cards
status_read_only — one mc-route.sh existing status call; read-only (GETs only); no card
existing_update_no_new_card — one existing update call on that card; no new card
existing_cancel — one existing cancel call; cancel = archive; cancels every same-title duplicate
found_newest_same_title — same-title cards are ONE job carded twice, NOT ambiguity: newest is acted on
ambiguous_or_not_found_change_nothing — AMBIGUOUS (several differently-titled matches) or NOT_FOUND (none); both exit 3, nothing created or changed
failed_escalate_to_operator — exit 1, FAILED + ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR; never NOT_FOUND; no card
reply_english_only — the owner-facing reply is English only, regardless of the message's language

You answer conversation and informational questions directly yourself." Worked example 3 in the same POLICY: "'Out of curiosity, how many clients do we have in Texas?' -> answer it, no call."

Cancel archives them all." scripts/mc-route.sh:404-414 (FOUND when all matches share one title; duplicates listed) and 490-504 (cancel archives every duplicate).

items.message: Cancel the thing — you know the one I mean.
items.board: Loaded and reachable. The reference matches several differently-titled cards (AMBIGUOUS) or nothing at all (NOT_FOUND); never a raw substring match.
items.expected_detail: AMBIGUOUS when several differently-titled cards match — ask the owner which one, or re-run with its id; NOT_FOUND when none does — tell the owner nothing matching is on the board to cancel and do NOT create a card. Both exit 3 and change nothing.
items.rule: scripts/mc-route.sh:40-42 (EXISTING MODE header): "No match -> `mc-route: NOT_FOUND ...` (update: new work, run `task`; status or cancel: tell the owner, NO card), several differently-titled matches -> `mc-route: AMBIGUOUS ...` with the candidates; both exit 3 and change nothing." scripts/mc-route.sh:26-28: "finds ONE task ... by exact id, exact title, or a WHOLE-WORD match at 1.0 on the title -- never a raw substring and never a partial score"; 387-393: "A task matches only when every word of the reference appears in its title as a whole word." 444-457: AMBIGUOUS prints and exits 3; cancel NOT_FOUND prints "nothing matching is on the board to cancel. Tell the owner; do NOT create a card." and exits 3.

items.message: What's on the board right now?
items.board: Reachable, but the task list comes back EMPTY (zero cards).
items.expected_detail: Fail-closed: an empty task list is a broken read, so the script exits 1 with FAILED + ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR — NEVER a false NOT_FOUND, and no card. The CEO tells the owner it is escalating to the operator and does not retry. (NOT_FOUND is only ever said of a list that loaded successfully and genuinely holds no match — e.g. a non-empty board with other cards.)
items.rule: scripts/mc-route.sh:36-39 (EXISTING MODE header): "FAIL-CLOSED (JEV-802): if the task list or the department list cannot be read, or comes back empty, or the matcher itself fails, this exits 1 with FAILED + ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR -- never NOT_FOUND. NOT_FOUND is only ever said of a list that loaded successfully and genuinely holds no match." scripts/mc-route.sh:355-358 (matcher load): "an unreadable file, a payload with no rows, or a row with no id is a broken read -- exit 4 so the caller escalates. It must never come back as an empty list, because empty reads as 'NONE' and NONE reads as 'the owner's work does not exist'." scripts/mc-route.sh:424-427: "the matcher could not read the board it was given. That is not 'no matching card' -- never let it reach the NOT_FOUND text." scripts/mc-route.sh:173-177 (_escalate): "mc-route: FAILED — ... ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR: task routing failed. The CEO must tell the owner it is escalating this to the operator. Do NOT self-intake, do NOT ask intake questions, do NOT retry."

items.message: Any updates on the summer catalog?

items.expected_detail: Fail-closed FAILED + ESCALATE_TO_OPERATOR (exit 1), never a false NOT_FOUND; nothing created or changed; the CEO tells the owner it is escalating to the operator, and does not retry or self-intake.
items.rule: scripts/mc-route.sh:36-39 (EXISTING MODE header) quoted in row ACC-001-13; scripts/mc-route.sh:306 (department list unreadable -> escalate); 308-311 (JEV-802: "an unreadable or EMPTY department list is not a board without departments. Escalate here, so no later lookup can read it as 'no matching department' and report a miss it never proved."); 327-332 (non-2xx task list -> escalate "could not read the task list (GET /api/tasks HTTP $API_CODE); nothing was changed"); 424-427 (matcher failure -> escalate, never NOT_FOUND).
